desc:
CREAMY WHITE FROSTING: A delicious creamy frosting that's perfect for cakes, cupcakes and cookies

QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting and enjoy

RICH & CREAMY: This frosting is decadent and creamy and ready for baked treats

GLUTEN FREE: Enjoy delicious gluten-free frosting on your favorite desserts

CONTAINS: 16 oz
features:
Key Features:

Ready-to-Use Frosting: No mixing needed—spread straight from the tub.

Rich, Creamy Texture: Smooth and velvety, ideal for cakes, cupcakes, cookies, and more.

Gluten-Free: Safe for gluten-sensitive individuals.

Generous Size: One tub is enough to frost standard cakes or several dozen cupcakes.

Reliable Brand: Made by Betty Crocker with consistent flavor and texture.

Benefits:

Time-Saving Convenience: Skip the prep—just open and decorate.

Ideal for All Skill Levels: Great for beginners or kids—no decorating tools required.

Versatile Use: Works for spreading, piping, or sandwiching into dessert creations.

Consistent Flavor: Delivers a classic sweet vanilla profile that’s crowd-pleasing.

Handy Pantry Staple: Shelf-stable until opened, making it a dependable dessert go-to.
ingredients: Sugar, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Water. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Monoglycerides, Polysorbate 60, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Artificial Flavor, Citric Acid. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
